newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.07 down in the kerb market at 40.15 to the dollar on Tuesday on fresh dollar demand sparked by political uncertainty, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open lower on Wednesday.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 8.20 percent.
